source_corpus: internal corpus of GoCortex modelling rules
notes: Synonyms are normalised: lowercased, dots/hyphens/spaces converted to underscores, leading underscores and a single 'tmp_' prefix stripped. Frequency = number of distinct rule blocks that map this xdm path. exampleVendors lists up to 12 vendors observed using this path.

schema.anchors: Object keyed by canonical xdm.* path. Each value has { frequency: int, synonyms: Array<{synonym: string, count: int}>, exampleVendors: string[] }. The synonyms array is sorted by descending count then alphabetic; the original task brief described a bare string array, but this richer shape is kept because consumers (linter, IDE quick-fix, training-data ranker) all need the per-synonym frequency. To recover the brief's shape, map `synonyms` to `synonyms.map(s => s.synonym)`.
